source_text:
Βδέλλα, ἔστι φύσις ἀκάθαρτος τὸ δίκαιον αἶμα ἐκ τῶν λογικῶν ψυχῶν
ἐκμυζῶσα. ΚΕʹ. Ἅδης, ἔστιν ἄγνοια φύσεως λογικῆς κατὰ στέρησιν τοῦ Θεοῦ θεωρίας ἐπισυμβαίνουσα. Κϛʹ. Γυνὴ, ἔστιν ἀφροσύνη λογικὰς ψυχὰς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίαν προσκαλουμένη. ΚΖʹ. Γῆ, ἔστιν ἕξις χειρίστη ἐξ ἀσεβείας καὶ παρανομίας συλλεγομένη. ΚΗʹ. Πῦρ, ἔστι κακία φύσεως λογικῆς φθαρτικὴ τῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀρετῶν. ΚΘʹ. Ὕδωρ, ἔστι γνῶσις ψευδὴς σβεστικὴ γνώσεως ἀληθοῦς. Λʹ. Ὀφθαλμὸς καταγελῶν, ἔστι φύσις ἀκάθαρτος τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ καταγελῶσα γνώσεως καὶ ἀτιμάζουσα τὴν ἐν τοῖς γεγονόσι σοφίαν. ΛΑʹ. Κόρακες, εἰσὶ δυνάμεις ἅγιαι, φθαρτικαὶ τῶν κακιῶν. ΛΒʹ. Φάραγγες, εἰσὶ ψυχαὶ λογικαὶ κοιλανθεῖσαι ἀπὸ κακίας καὶ ἀγνωσίας. ΛΓʹ. Νεοσσοὶ ἀετῶν, εἰσὶ δυνάμεις ἅγιαι τοὺς ἀκαθάρτους καταβάλλειν πεπιστευμέναι. 2
thought_title: Unclean Powers, False Knowledge, and Holy Powers
orientation: Evagrius continues his symbolic definitions, now listing unclean powers, false knowledge, and holy powers that oppose or destroy vices.
pass_a_gloss: A leech, [it] is an unclean power the just blood from the rational souls sucking out. 25. Hades, [it] is ignorance of a rational nature according to deprivation of the contemplation of God supervening. 26. A woman, [she] is folly rational souls to uncleanness summoning. 27. Earth, [it] is a disposition most wicked from impiety and lawlessness gathered together. 28. Fire, [it] is vice of a rational nature destructive of the virtues of God. 29. Water, [it] is knowledge false quenching of knowledge true. 30. An eye mocking, [it] is an unclean power at the knowledge of God mocking and dishonoring the wisdom in the things that have come to be. 31. Ravens, [they] are holy powers, destructive of vices. 32. Ravines, [they] are rational souls hollowed out from vice and ignorance. 33. Eaglets, [they] are holy powers the unclean ones to cast down entrusted.

choices.why: The literal animal name, kept as in the source; it symbolizes an unclean power.
The proper name of the underworld, kept as a name rather than translated as 'hell' to preserve the Greek term.
The literal noun, used symbolically for folly; 'woman' preserves the symbolic figure.
The literal element, used symbolically for a wicked disposition.
The participial phrase rendered literally to preserve the symbolic figure.
The literal term for young eagles, kept as a single noun for the symbolic holy powers.

pass_b_english: A leech is an unclean power that sucks the righteous blood out of rational souls.
Hades is ignorance that comes upon a rational nature through the deprivation of the contemplation of God.
A woman is folly that summons rational souls to uncleanness.
Earth is a most wicked disposition gathered together from impiety and lawlessness.
Fire is a vice of rational nature that destroys the virtues of God.
Water is false knowledge that extinguishes true knowledge.
A mocking eye is an unclean power that mocks the knowledge of God and dishonors the wisdom in created things.
Ravens are holy powers that destroy vices.
Ravines are rational souls hollowed out by vice and ignorance.
Eaglets are holy powers entrusted with casting down the unclean.
